name: hexabuddy-workspace
description: Watch Codex and Claude Code sessions from the Hexabuddy phone app, answer agent questions there, and send selected words to your buddy.

interface.shortDescription: Your coding sessions on your phone
interface.longDescription: Connect this Mac to the Hexabuddy app with one phone scan. Session status appears on the phone, agent questions are answered there, and Translate → Buddy sends a selected word to your desk buddy. Disconnect removes everything again.
